如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    想到这里，杨云帆便没了兴趣，准备回家炼制符箓了。可不料这时，他一转身，却是碰上了迎面而来的两个人。
“哎呦！”
那人痛叫了一声，张嘴就骂道：“你这人怎么回事？走路不长眼睛啊？撞坏了我的宝贝，你赔的起吗？”
这家伙骂人中气十足，哪里像是被撞痛了的样子。
其实，杨云帆并没有撞上他，在两人发生碰撞的瞬间，杨云帆的身子就本能的做出了闪躲，往一旁轻微小迈出了一步。就这一小步，不多不少，恰好躲开了碰撞上来到那人。
这一步极为隐秘，不是高手绝对看不出来。
岂料跟这人一起过来的老者，却是一个练家子，被杨云帆这步伐给吸引住了，连连打量杨云帆，赞叹道：“小兄弟是哪家的子弟？功夫不差嘛！没有十几年的功夫打磨，一般人可做不到你这衣不沾水的境界。”
这几步便是“虎鹤双形”之中的“鹤形灵步”，轻灵迅速，不着痕迹。一个小空间内，一盆水泼下来，一点也沾不上他的衣服。练到了这个境界，就是老者口中的“衣不沾水”了。
杨云帆没有料到一个世俗之人竟然有如此眼力，有些惊讶。微微抱拳道：“我叫杨云帆。”
“姓杨？湘潭这边，我好像没听过杨家啊？真奇怪，有你这样的年轻人。杨家怎么会名声不显？”老者倒是奇怪的很。
杨云帆看他的穿着气度，巍然如岳，俨然一方人物。而且听老者的口音，不是湘潭本地人，倒像是京城那边来的。杨云帆怎么看，都无法将这老者跟旁边这位一脸煞气的中年人联系上。
不得不说，杨云帆的感觉很敏锐。
这老者是来湘潭度假的。而他前几日恰好在古玩街里碰到了这中年人。而这中年人得知老者正在寻找上好的古玉，而他手里正好有一批高仿玉器赝品需要找个“肥羊”兜售，便找了关系，与这老者接触上了。今日，就是来看货的。
不过，这些跟杨云帆没有多大关系，他也不想跟眼前这个老者发生多大关系，随口道：“老先生要是没什么事的话，我就先走了。”
“既然这样，那我们下次有缘再见了。”老者虽然有些遗憾，但是跟杨云帆没什么交情，当然不好拦着他。
不过，这老者让杨云帆离开，另外那个中年男子却是不依不饶道：“想就这么走了？恐怕没那么容易吧？难道撞了人，你连道歉都不说一句？天下没有这个道理！”
明明是对方撞上来的，这时候却黑白颠倒。
杨云帆脚步一怔，不怒反笑道：“那你想怎么样？”
“知道这小东西多少钱吗？”
那中年人冷眼瞧了杨云帆一眼，还扬了扬自己手里的一个彩绘的鼻烟壶，道：“说出来吓死你！也亏了你运气好，我撞上来，你躲开了。要是刚才我不小心摔了，哼哼！”

这年头，还有人说话这么不讲理？
这个时候，其他人听到了那男子说的话，纷纷都围了过来。
“是吗？”
杨云帆却是轻笑一声道：“你倒是说说，这个小东西多少钱？试试看，能不能把我吓死？”
杨云帆这么一说，周围围观的人都轰然大笑起来。也都纷纷道：“对啊，你倒是说说，这个小东西多值钱？也试试看，能不能把我们吓死。”
古玩街不少都是有钱人，玩这个的，几百万几千万都不算钱。小小的鼻烟壶，顶天了，也就百来万。他们还真看不上眼。
见到刚才还很空的街道，忽然涌出来这么多人，那中年人越发得瑟了，大声道：“就让你们见识见识！”
说着，他将一个彩绘的鼻烟壶拿出来，道：“看仔细了，这个是乾隆年间的极品鼻烟壶。这一款鼻烟壶上，画的可是御制铜胎画珐琅彩欧式仕女图。前几天刚有个拍卖行正好卖出了一个一模一样的，成交价格是五百万！”
听到这么个还没巴掌大的东西，就值五百万。
杨云帆心中感叹，这古玩果然是有钱人玩的东西。
不过，当杨云帆运转灵力到双眼时，却是看到那鼻烟壶根本没有什么“紫色贵气”。
这种情况，只有一种可能，这东西是个假货！
只是这些假货造的比较真，如果不是专业人士用专业的工具来查看的话，恐怕很难辨认出它们的真伪。
周围这些人中不少人都是在这行混了很久，这时候也没瞧出什么不对劲来。

If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author's copyright complaint fast track. Thinking of this, Yang Yunfan lost interest and was ready to go home and refine the talismans. But unexpectedly, when he turned around, he ran into two people coming towards him.
"Ouch!"
The man screamed in pain, opened his mouth and cursed: "What's wrong with you? You don't have eyes when you walk? You broke my baby, can you afford to pay for it?"
This guy was very angry when he cursed, and he looked like he had been hurt.
In fact, Yang Yunfan did not hit him. The moment the two collided, Yang Yunfan's body instinctively dodged and took a slight step to the side. Just this small step, no more, no less, just avoided the collision and came up to the person.
This step is extremely secretive, and even a non-expert would never be able to spot it.
Unexpectedly, the old man who came with this man was a martial artist. He was attracted by Yang Yunfan's pace. He looked at Yang Yunfan repeatedly and praised: "Which family is this little brother from? Your kung fu is not bad! Without more than ten years of hard work, ordinary people cannot achieve the level you are without getting wet."
These steps are the "crane-shaped spiritual steps" among the "tiger-crane double-shaped". They are light and fast, leaving no trace. In a small space, a basin of water was poured down, but it didn't touch his clothes at all. Once you have reached this level, you are what the old man calls "the clothes you wear without getting wet."
Yang Yunfan did not expect that a secular person would have such discernment, and was a little surprised. Weiwei cupped her fists and said, "My name is Yang Yunfan."
"Your surname is Yang? I don't think I've heard of the Yang family here in Xiangtan? It's strange that there is a young man like you. How come the Yang family is not famous?" The old man was very strange.
Yang Yunfan looked at the way he was dressed and looked like a tall man. And from the old man's accent, he was not from Xiangtan, but rather from the capital. No matter how Yang Yunfan looked, he couldn't connect the old man with the middle-aged man next to him with a sinister look on his face.
It must be said that Yang Yunfan's senses are very keen.
This old man came to Xiangtan for vacation. And he happened to meet this middle-aged man in the antique street a few days ago. And the middle-aged man learned that the old man was looking for good ancient jade, and he happened to have a batch of high-quality imitation jade fakes that he needed to find a "fat sheep" to sell, so he found a relationship and got in touch with the old man. Today, I just came to see the goods.
However, these had little to do with Yang Yunfan, and he didn't want to have much to do with the old man in front of him, so he said casually: "If nothing happens, old gentleman, I will leave first."
"In this case, let's meet again next time." Although the old man was a little regretful, he had no friendship with Yang Yunfan, so it was certainly not easy to stop him.
However, the old man asked Yang Yunfan to leave, but the other middle-aged man said reluctantly: "You want to leave like this? I'm afraid it's not that easy, right? Did you bump into someone and you didn't even say an apology? There is no such thing in the world!"
It was obviously the other party who bumped into him, but right and wrong were reversed at this moment.
Yang Yunfan hesitated, then smiled instead of getting angry and said, "Then what do you want?"
"Do you know how much this little thing costs?"
The middle-aged man gave Yang Yunfan a cold look, raised a painted snuff bottle in his hand, and said, "I'll scare you to death if I tell you! It's also your good luck that I bumped into you and you avoided it. If I had accidentally dropped it just now, huh!"
Is there anyone who speaks so unreasonably these days?
At this time, other people heard what the man said and gathered around.
"Really?"
Yang Yunfan chuckled lightly and said, "Tell me, how much does this little thing cost? Try it and see if it can scare me to death?"
When Yang Yunfan said this, the onlookers burst into laughter. They all said, "Yes, tell me, how valuable is this little thing? Give it a try and see if it can scare us to death."
Many of the antique streets are filled with rich people, playingFor this, millions and tens of millions are not considered money. A small snuff bottle is as big as the sky, and it only costs a million. They really don't like it.
Seeing so many people suddenly pouring out of the empty street just now, the middle-aged man became more and more angry and said loudly: "I'll show you!"
As he spoke, he took out a painted snuff bottle and said: "Look carefully, this is a top-quality snuff bottle from the Qianlong period. This snuff bottle is painted with an imperial bronze enamel painting of a European-style lady. An auction house just sold an identical one a few days ago, and the transaction price was five million!"
Hearing something like this, which is no bigger than a palm, is worth five million.
Yang Yunfan sighed in his heart, this antique is indeed a thing for rich people.
However, when Yang Yunfan channeled his spiritual power into his eyes, he saw that the snuff bottle had no "purple nobility" at all.
In this case, there is only one possibility, this thing is a fake!
It's just that these fakes are relatively real. If professionals don't use professional tools to check them, it may be difficult to identify their authenticity.
Many of the people around me have been in this business for a long time, and they didn't see anything wrong at this time.
